title: There's a ChatGPT prompt that reads your entire chat history and tells you things about yourself
description:
There's a prompt that makes ChatGPT tell you things about yourself you have never said out loud to anyone.

It doesn't guess, it reads every conversation you've ever had with it, not just this one, and looks for patterns you never pointed out yourself. The exact prompt: ask it for five things it's figured out about you that you've never directly said, and tell it not to hold back. The first answer alone is usually the one that gets people. A second prompt pushes further, asking it to name the patterns in how you think and how you decide.

Comment SECRET and I'll send you the exact prompt.

#ai #chatgpt #chatgptprompts #psychology #selfawareness #aitools #mindblown #artificialintelligence #technews #curiosity
